name: trae-java-navigator
description: Java symbol navigation and real-time diagnostics for Trae agents via JDT LS (LSP).

interface.shortDescription: Java symbols, definitions, references, and live compile errors
interface.longDescription: An MCP server that talks to the Eclipse JDT language server. Agents can find class/method/field locations, jump to definitions, find references, read hovers and query real-time Java diagnostics without running Maven. Use it when the declaring file is unknown or exact semantics matter (same-name/overload, real references); Read/Grep are faster for known files, plain text, and non-Java files. Not for renaming/refactoring, call/type/implementation hierarchies, or final build verification.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find the Java symbol I mention, show its definition/references, and read its real-time compiler errors.
